The trinomial x2 + 5x + 6 can be factored.
x2 + 5x + 6 = (x + 2)(x + 3)
Check that these factors are also factors of P(x) = x4 + 5x3 + 2x2 – 20x – 24 by using the factor theorem.

Since x + 2 and x + 3 are both factors of P(x), then their product, x2 + 5x + 6, is also a factor of P(x).

materials.html:
Let x represent the side length of the base. Then, V(x) = x2(x + 4).
Solve x2(x + 4) = 225.
Since 25 is a factor of 225, and 25 is a square, try x = 5 as a solution.

Thus, x = 5 is a solution. The dimensions of the box could be 5 cm by 5 cm by 9 cm.
Rewrite the equation in the form P(x) = 0.

Since x = 5 is a solution, x - 5 is a factor of P(x). Divide to find another factor.


x2 + 9x + 45 = 0 has no real solutions. So the only solution is x = 5. The dimensions of the box are 5 cm by 5 cm by 9 cm.

stem.text: Maria is designing a series of stationery trays for holding paper and envelopes. Each tray starts as a rectangular sheet of metal from which identical squares are cut from the four corners. The resulting rectangular flaps are then folded up and welded to produce an open-topped rectangular tray. What size square should Maria cut from a rectangular sheet of metal 15 cm by 25 cm in order to produce a tray with a volume of 476 cm#super[3];? Round to the nearest hundredth of a centimetre, if necesary.

Both sides of the equation can be divided by x2 + 1 because it is always positive. When x < -1, both factors are negative, so their product is positive. When -1 < x < 1, x - 1 is negative and x + 1 is positive, so their product is negative. When x > 1, both factors are positive, so their product is positive.
Combining the results, the solution is x < –1 or x > 1.
